title: Mobile Settings Page & Page Transition Scrollbar Containment
summary: Renders Settings as a dedicated page on mobile while maintaining the desktop modal experience using a shared component, and eliminates scrollbar appearance during page switches.

changes.text: Mobile Settings Page: rendered Scanner AI Settings as a dedicated full page on mobile (/settings) using the shared ScannerSettingsContent component.
Desktop Modal & Shared Architecture: preserved the desktop modal experience with portal and squash-and-stretch motion while sharing 100% of the settings logic and UI cards.
Page Transition Scrollbar Elimination: added overflow-x containment and clamped vertical scale overshoot during squash-and-stretch animations to eliminate transient scrollbars during page switches.
